{"schema_version":1,"rules":[
{"id":"port.docker_api.exposed","version":1,"title":"Docker API is exposed","severity":"critical","confidence":90,"expression":"'2375' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"The unencrypted Docker API (tcp 2375) listens on a non-loopback address; anyone who reaches it controls the host. Bind it to a Unix socket or loopback, or use TLS on 2376."},
{"id":"port.telnet.exposed","version":1,"title":"Telnet is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'23' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Telnet (tcp 23) listens on a non-loopback address; it sends passwords in clear text. Disable it and use SSH."},
{"id":"port.rsh.exposed","version":1,"title":"rsh/rlogin/rexec is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'512' in facts['port.tcp.exposed'] || '513' in facts['port.tcp.exposed'] || '514' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"rexec, rlogin or rsh (tcp 512-514) listens on a non-loopback address; these trust host names and send credentials in clear text. Disable them and use SSH."},
{"id":"port.vnc.exposed","version":1,"title":"VNC is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'5900' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"VNC (tcp 5900) listens on a non-loopback address; it is often weakly authenticated and unencrypted. Bind it to loopback and tunnel it over SSH, or firewall it."},
{"id":"port.redis.exposed","version":1,"title":"Redis is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'6379' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Redis (tcp 6379) listens on a non-loopback address; by default it has no password and can be used to write files. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and require authentication."},
{"id":"port.mongodb.exposed","version":1,"title":"MongoDB is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'27017' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"MongoDB (tcp 27017) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and enable authentication."},
{"id":"port.elasticsearch.exposed","version":1,"title":"Elasticsearch is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'9200' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"Elasticsearch (tcp 9200) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it and enable security."},
{"id":"port.memcached.exposed","version":1,"title":"memcached is exposed","severity":"high","confidence":90,"expression":"'11211' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"memcached (tcp 11211) listens on a non-loopback address; it has no authentication and can leak cached data. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it."},
{"id":"port.ftp.exposed","version":1,"title":"FTP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'21' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"FTP (tcp 21) listens on a non-loopback address; it sends passwords in clear text. Use SFTP, or firewall it."},
{"id":"port.smb.exposed","version":1,"title":"SMB is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'139' in facts['port.tcp.exposed'] || '445' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"SMB (tcp 139 or 445) listens on a non-loopback address. Firewall it to the networks that need file sharing."},
{"id":"port.snmp.exposed","version":1,"title":"SNMP is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'161' in facts['port.udp.exposed']","finding_message":"SNMP (udp 161) listens on a non-loopback address; v1/v2c community strings are sent in clear text. Firewall it, or use SNMPv3."},
{"id":"port.postgresql.exposed","version":1,"title":"PostgreSQL is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'5432' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"PostgreSQL (tcp 5432) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it to the hosts that need it."},
{"id":"port.mysql.exposed","version":1,"title":"MySQL is exposed","severity":"medium","confidence":90,"expression":"'3306' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"MySQL or MariaDB (tcp 3306) listens on a non-loopback address. Bind it to loopback, or firewall it to the hosts that need it."},
{"id":"port.ssh.exposed","version":1,"title":"SSH is exposed","severity":"low","confidence":90,"expression":"'22' in facts['port.tcp.exposed']","finding_message":"SSH (tcp 22) listens on a non-loopback address. If the host is reachable from untrusted networks, allow keys only and firewall it."},
{"id":"package.telnet_server.installed","version":1,"title":"Telnet server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'telnet-server' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"The telnet-server package is installed. Remove it and use SSH."},
{"id":"package.rsh_server.installed","version":1,"title":"rsh server is installed","severity":"low","confidence":100,"expression":"'rsh-server' in facts['package.names']","finding_message":"The rsh-server package is installed. Remove it and use SSH."}
]}
